original_request: Add operator documentation for integration & observability features
questions_asked: Which integration & observability features are missing operator documentation?
What is the scope of the documentation gap?

evidence.content: erweitere den letzten intake die US-113 darum, das alle fehlenden erweiterten feature beschriebungen ins readme erweitert werdden müssen, nicht nur die 'sovereign-loop era (US-0103–US-0112)'

Feature audit identified integration & observability family: US-0034 (cross-repo observability), US-0084 (codebase map), US-0086 (multi-repo contracts), US-0093 (scratchpad drift), US-0096 (active context handoff), US-0101 (model tier), US-0102 (role-based model catalog) need operator-facing documentation in the framework README

acceptance_criteria: AC-1: Integration & observability umbrella section under Commands & workflow
AC-3: Full scratchpad reference extension with integration & observability keys
decomposition_rationale: Vertical slice by functional family; integration & observability shares operator workflows
